@graph.name: EarlyJobs
@graph.description: EarlyJobs is a recruiter-first hiring network connecting employers, independent recruiters, recruitment partners and job seekers through recruiter-led hiring and AI-assisted recruitment workflows.

@graph.name: Become a Recruiter | Flexible Recruitment Opportunities | EarlyJobs
@graph.description: Join EarlyJobs as a freelance recruiter to explore available hiring mandates, develop recruitment skills, work flexibly and earn commissions on eligible successful placements.

@graph.name: Freelance Recruiter Network
@graph.serviceType: Freelance recruitment opportunities and recruiter network access
@graph.description: EarlyJobs connects freelance recruiters with available recruitment mandates and a wider hiring network. Depending on eligibility and programme terms, participants can source candidates, coordinate recruitment activities, develop their skills and earn commissions for eligible successful placements.

@graph.name: Benefits of Joining the EarlyJobs Recruiter Network
@graph.description: Key features of the freelance recruiter opportunity offered through EarlyJobs.

itemListElement.name: Access to hiring opportunities
itemListElement.description: Explore recruitment mandates made available through the EarlyJobs network, subject to eligibility and availability.

itemListElement.name: Flexible working
itemListElement.description: Work with greater flexibility in location and schedule while meeting agreed recruitment requirements and deadlines.

itemListElement.name: Performance-based earnings
itemListElement.description: Earn applicable recruitment commissions on eligible successful placements under agreed commercial terms. Earnings are not guaranteed.

itemListElement.name: Recruitment skill development
itemListElement.description: Develop practical experience in candidate sourcing, screening, communication and recruitment coordination.

itemListElement.name: AI-assisted recruitment
itemListElement.description: Use recruitment technology and available workflows to support candidate discovery and recruitment activities.
